## Goal
- QA-audit the failed IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline, fix verified failures on `main`, and confirm validation gates unblock E2E jobs.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use GitHub repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` on `main`.
- Do not hide failures with `@ts-ignore`, broad `any`, disabled checks, `continue-on-error`, or `|| true`.
- Preserve frozen lockfile enforcement.
- Do not expose credential values.
- Avoid committing `.rork/history/main/` or generated report artifacts.

## Progress
### Done
- Audited failed post-fix workflow run #573:
  - Run ID: `30728036507`
  - URL: `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/runs/30728036507`
  - Head SHA: `127e9e8dda1459003a4416dc32da19ee3251aa85`
- Identified run #573 failure as dependency installation:
  - `Lint` job ID `91443268319` failed at `bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd expo`.
  - `TypeScript typecheck` job ID `91443268343` failed at `Install deps (root + expo)`.
- Determined published GitHub lockfiles differed from locally validated lockfiles:
  - Remote `bun.lock`: blob `03e37d59a0238e405eaacf6d2b85e406a672c8ed`, size `99142`.
  - Local `bun.lock`: blob `af5b31d767d0c136a5ade4b03bc2971fe7bd9ba6`, size `104616`.
  - Remote `expo/bun.lock`: blob `66366d830ff42198aa208d21aadb584682d70134`, size `428135`.
  - Local `expo/bun.lock`: blob `979fae5902123f73a3620cce0efb4cdbd0ba0fc5`, size `428940`.
- Verified locally with Bun `1.3.9`:
  - `bun install --frozen-lockfile` passed.
  - `bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd expo` passed.
  - `bun x tsc --noEmit` passed.
  - `cd expo && bun x tsc --noEmit` passed.
  - `bun run --cwd expo lint` passed with existing warnings.
- Published corrected lockfiles:
  - Commit SHA: `107c3c47af35c414f20351fae856b9c9909428aa`
  - Message: `fix(ci): synchronize Bun lockfiles`
- Run #574 started:
  - Run ID: `30728172307`
  - URL: `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/runs/30728172307`
  - Head SHA: `107c3c47af35c414f20351fae856b9c9909428aa`
- Run #574 confirms lockfile correction worked:
  - `Lint` job ID `91443622940`: passed.
  - Both frozen dependency installs in `TypeScript typecheck` completed successfully.
- Inspected the affected source excerpts on the current available workspace:
  - `backend/api/ivx-member-classification.ts` currently casts results through `unknown as Record<string, unknown>` at lines `146` and `155`; line `181` remains to inspect.
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-control-proof.ts` currently uses `rork.externalRequired` at response lines `202` and `219`, consistent with `detectExternalRuntimeDependency()` returning `{ externalRequired, references }`.
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` currently obtains blockers with a narrow record cast:
    `const _blockersRaw = (_proof as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.blockers ?? [];`
  - `backend/hono.ts` imports `handleIVXOwnerControlProofRequest` from `./api/ivx-owner-control-proof`.

### In Progress
- Retrieve the complete root `Typecheck (root)` error list from job `91443622969`.
- Compare GitHub `main` source at `107c3c47af35c414f20351fae856b9c9909428aa` with the local workspace, which is on a different observed Git history.
- Reconcile the CI-reported source state with currently inspected files, since some reported stale-field errors appear already corrected locally.
- Apply direct type-safe fixes to every CI-reported root TypeScript error.
- Publish and verify a follow-up CI run.

### Blocked
- Run #574 `TypeScript typecheck` is failing at root TypeScript validation; downstream E2E jobs remain blocked by `needs: [typecheck]`.
- Local `bun x tsc --noEmit` passes, but GitHub CI compiles a different effective source baseline than the local workspace:
  - Local observed `HEAD`: `b052adbfe9353e9f9a16a3e868c6766e265c84c3`.
  - GitHub pipeline head: `107c3c47af35c414f20351fae856b9c9909428aa`.
- Root `package.json` has no `lint` script; `bun run lint` prints Bun usage output. The workflow only runs Expo lint.

## Key Decisions
- Keep Bun pinned to `1.3.9` in `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`; it is the version verified against synchronized lockfiles.
- Preserve `--frozen-lockfile`; correct committed lockfiles rather than weakening integrity checks.
- Treat run #574 as a successful lockfile remediation and a newly unmasked root TypeScript failure.
- Fix CI diagnostics in source/types directly; do not suppress TypeScript errors.
- Use GitHub’s exact checked-out `main` source as the authority for remaining fixes, because local and GitHub histories differ.
- Prefer structural/narrow type-safe serialization fixes over broad casts; the currently observed `unknown as Record<string, unknown>` casts may not satisfy the stated constraint and require review.

## Next Steps
1. Download and inspect the complete `Typecheck (root)` log for job `91443622969`.
2. Fetch/read each affected file from GitHub `main` at `107c3c47af35c414f20351fae856b9c9909428aa`, including the full relevant functions.
3. Determine whether the reported `rorkRequired` and `.blockers` errors correspond to older remote contents or a different compile target.
4. Make narrow type-safe fixes for all confirmed root TypeScript diagnostics.
5. Validate against the exact remote source/lockfile baseline:
   - `bun install --frozen-lockfile`
   - `bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd expo`
   - `bun x tsc --noEmit`
   - `cd expo && bun x tsc --noEmit`
   - `bun run --cwd expo lint`
6. Publish a corrective commit to `main`.
7. Confirm `TypeScript typecheck` and `Lint` pass, then verify Playwright and Maestro scheduling/results.

## Critical Context
- Original requested run:
  - Run number: `569`
  - Run ID: `30727630249`
  - URL: `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/runs/30727630249`
  - Head SHA: `848f8e8541a0c4328149ffa8747ddfbfd543e5df`
- Run #569 root cause:
  - Bun `1.3.14` rejected committed lockfiles with `error: lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen`.
- Workflow correction commit:
  - SHA: `127e9e8dda1459003a4416dc32da19ee3251aa85`
  - Message: `fix(ci): restore frozen installs and TypeScript checks`
- Lockfile correction commit:
  - SHA: `107c3c47af35c414f20351fae856b9c9909428aa`
  - Message: `fix(ci): synchronize Bun lockfiles`
- Run #574 root TypeScript diagnostics reported:
  - `backend/__tests__/ivx-app-generator-gate5.test.ts(145,7): error TS2578: Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-member-classification.ts(146,24): error TS2345: Argument of type 'ClassificationResult' is not assignable to parameter of type 'Record<string, unknown>'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-member-classification.ts(155,24): error TS2345: Argument of type 'ReconciliationResult' is not assignable to parameter of type 'Record<string, unknown>'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-member-classification.ts(181,24): error TS2345: Argument of type 'ManualOverrideResult' is not assignable to parameter of type 'Record<string, unknown>'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts(8185,33): error TS2339: Property 'blockers' does not exist on type 'IVXSeniorDeveloperRunProof'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-control-proof.ts(202,28): error TS2339: Property 'rorkRequired' does not exist on type '{ externalRequired: boolean; references: string[]; }'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-control-proof.ts(219,81): error TS2339: Property 'rorkRequired' does not exist on type '{ externalRequired: boolean; references: string[]; }'.`
- Current inspected workspace differs from these exact CI diagnostics:
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-control-proof.ts` uses `externalRequired`, not `rorkRequired`, in inspected response lines `202` and `219`.
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` uses a cast-based access path for `blockers` in inspected line `8185`.
  - `backend/api/ivx-member-classification.ts` uses cast-based calls at inspected lines `146` and `155`.
- Current workflow commands:
  - Root typecheck: `bunx tsc --noEmit`
  - Expo typecheck: `cd expo && bunx tsc --noEmit`
  - Expo lint: `bun run --cwd expo lint`
- Existing local Expo lint warnings are non-fatal and do not fail the workflow.

## Relevant Files
- `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`: pins Bun `1.3.9`, enforces frozen installs, and defines CI gates.
- `bun.lock`: root lockfile synchronized in commit `107c3c47af35c414f20351fae856b9c9909428aa`.
- `expo/bun.lock`: Expo lockfile synchronized in commit `107c3c47af35c414f20351fae856b9c9909428aa`.
- `package.json`: root package manifest; has no root `lint` script.
- `expo/package.json`: Expo lint script is `bunx expo lint`.
- `backend/__tests__/ivx-app-generator-gate5.test.ts`: contains unused `@ts-expect-error` at line `145`.
- `backend/api/ivx-member-classification.ts`: classification handlers serialize `ClassificationResult`, `ReconciliationResult`, and `ManualOverrideResult`; CI reported incompatibility with `ownerOnlyJson`’s `Record<string, unknown>` input.
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts`: daily-improvement autonomous execution code; CI reported absent `IVXSeniorDeveloperRunProof.blockers` access near line `8185`.
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-control-proof.ts`: owner-control proof payload; runtime dependency detector returns `externalRequired` and `references`.
- `backend/hono.ts`: imports and registers API handlers, including `handleIVXOwnerControlProofRequest`.
- `/tmp/ivx-typecheck-574.log`: downloaded GitHub run #574 typecheck log containing CI diagnostics.

appId: com.ivxholdings.app
name: "IVX Chat QA — Full 20-Step Flow"
tags:
  - ios-qa
  - chat
  - owner
---

# Pre-conditions: OWNER_EMAIL and OWNER_PASSWORD env vars must be set.
# This flow exercises the complete IVX Owner AI Chat QA checklist.

# Step 1: Launch app
- launchApp:
    clearState: true

# Step 2: Owner login
- assertVisible: "IVX"
- tapOn:
    id: "home-owner-login-entry"
- assertVisible: "Owner Login"
- tapOn:
    id: "owner-login-password"
- inputText: ${OWNER_PASSWORD}
- tapOn:
    id: "owner-login-submit"

# Step 3: Open IVX Chat
- assertVisible: "IVX"
- tapOn: "IVX Owner AI"

# Step 4: Confirm latest conversation opens
- assertVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-list"
    timeout: 15000

# Step 5: Confirm newest message is visible
# Inverted FlatList: newest message is at the bottom (visible on first render)
- assertVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-list"
    timeout: 5000

# Step 6: Confirm yellow "scroll to latest" arrow is hidden on initial open
# The arrow only appears when user scrolls up; it must NOT be visible on initial load
- assertNotVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-scroll-to-latest"
    timeout: 3000

# Step 7: Send a message
- tapOn:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-input"
- inputText: "QA test message — iOS simulator verification"
- tapOn:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-send"

# Step 8: Confirm message appears exactly once
# Wait for the sent message to appear in the list
- assertVisible:
    text: "QA test message — iOS simulator verification"
    timeout: 10000

# Step 9: Receive or simulate authorized realtime reply
# The AI typing indicator should appear, then a response
- assertVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-typing-indicator"
    timeout: 8000
- assertNotVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-typing-indicator"
    timeout: 60000

# Step 10: Scroll to older messages
- scroll:
    direction: UP
    distance: 200

# Step 11: Trigger pagination — continue scrolling to trigger onEndReached
- scroll:
    direction: UP
    distance: 500
- scroll:
    direction: UP
    distance: 500

# Step 12: Confirm visible position remains stable (no jump)
# After pagination loads, the viewport should not jump
- assertVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-list"
    timeout: 5000

# Step 13: Return to latest — scroll back down
- scroll:
    direction: DOWN
    distance: 500
- scroll:
    direction: DOWN
    distance: 500

# Step 14: Open keyboard
- tapOn:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-input"

# Step 15: Enter multiline text
- inputText: "Line 1\nLine 2\nLine 3"

# Step 16: Close keyboard
- hideKeyboard

# Step 17: Background and resume
- backgroundApp
- launchApp:
    clearState: false

# Step 18: Restart app
- killApp
- launchApp:
    clearState: false

# Step 19: Reopen chat
- assertVisible: "IVX"
- tapOn: "IVX Owner AI"
- assertVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-list"
    timeout: 15000

# Step 20: Confirm newest message remains visible after restart
- assertVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-list"
    timeout: 5000
- assertNotVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-scroll-to-latest"
    timeout: 3000
